)

    a.first_name,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT f.`District Name`) AS districts,

ORDER BY nc.administrator_count DESC, a.first_name

    SELECT raceId, MAX(laps) AS laps
    FROM results
    GROUP BY raceId
),
max_laps AS (
    SELECT MAX(laps) AS laps
    FROM race_laps
)

       r.year,
       c.name AS circuit,
       c.lat AS circuit_lat,
       c.lng AS circuit_lng,
       rl.laps AS most_laps
FROM race_laps rl
JOIN max_laps ml ON ml.laps = rl.laps
JOIN races r ON r.raceId = rl.raceId
JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
ORDER BY r.year, r.round, r.name

      SELECT f2.`County Name`

      JOIN frpm f2 ON s2.CDSCode = f2.CDSCode

      ORDER BY COUNT(s2.School) DESC
      LIMIT 1

WITH win_counts AS (
    SELECT driverId, COUNT(*) AS wins
    FROM results
    WHERE positionOrder = 1
    GROUP BY driverId
    ORDER BY wins DESC, driverId
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT REPLACE(d.attr_001, CHAR(31), ' ') AS driver,
       d.nationality,
       (SELECT MAX(ds.points)
        FROM driverStandings ds
        WHERE ds.driverId = d.driverId) AS max_points
FROM drivers d
JOIN win_counts w ON w.driverId = d.driverId
